description: This file defines the CachedMessageBlock class, which manages a tightly packed block of cached messages used in Orleans stream cache management. It includes methods for adding, removing, and querying cached messages, as well as retrieving sequence tokens and searching within the block.

classes.name: CachedMessageBlock
classes.description: A class representing a block of cached messages with methods for managing and querying the messages within the block.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the start of the block.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new CachedMessage to the end of the block.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the message at a specific index.

methods.name: GetNewestSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the newest message in the block.

methods.name: GetOldestSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the oldest message in the block.

methods.name: GetIndexOfFirstMessageLessThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Finds the index of the first message with a sequence token less than or equal to the provided token.

methods.name: TryFindFirstMessage
methods.description: Attempts to find the first message in the block that belongs to a specific stream.

methods.name: TryFindNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to find the next message in the block belonging to a specific stream, starting from a given index.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the block, clearing message indices.
